quire the notion of space. Yet, most visual representation learning methods oper-
ate on individual images, while those that leverage multiple views rely on RGB

We find that stable and effective multi-view self-distillation relies on three key ingredients: introduc-
ing an image-level distillation objective, providing the teacher with access to additional views of the
scene, and retaining full images rather than using local and global crops. Together, these ingredients
give rise to Poincar3,1a multi-view self-supervised model that learns strong representations directly
from unlabeled image sequences mined from the internet. We illustrate its state-of-the-art empirical
performance in Fig. 1, and show that multi-view geometry emerges without labels, as evidenced by
zero-shot correspondences in Fig. 2.

evidence.excerpt:
We begin by considering feed-forward reconstruction (Wang et al., 2024; 2025), where a multi-view
transformer directly predicts scene geometry from a sequence of images. We consider three eval-
uation settings of increasing computational complexity (i) train only the pose and depth head, (ii)
train a transformer, and (iii) finetune the full model with new heads. We train on a large collection
of labeled 3D datasets using 4 H200 GPUs for each experiment and report the results in Tab. 1
together with training curves in Fig. 7. Poincar3 shows substantially improved performance, espe-
cially on camera pose estimation, compared to all existing models. Furthermore, initializing from
the Poincar3 weights allows for rapid finetuning, achieving an AUC@30◦ of 65.0%+ on RE10K af-
ter only 10K steps with a low learning rate. Further details can be found in Sec. E in the Appendix.

missing_information: No reproducible review or selection methodology was detected.

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Headline outcomes are measured with ground-truth camera poses, depths, and correspondences on held-out benchmarks such as RE10K, ScanNet++, MegaDepth, ETH3D, DTU, ScanNet, and NAVI, which are independent of the self-distillation training objective.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: Ground-truth geometric metrics on held-out benchmarks, including pose AUC, point cloud error, normal consistency, and PCK correspondence accuracy.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Multi-view self-distillation loss combining masked patch distillation, global CLS cross-entropy against an EMA teacher with extra views, and KoLeo regularization.

primary.claim_evidence_alignment: Claims regarding superior geometric transfer over RGB-reconstruction multi-view SSL and single-view self-distillation are well supported by quantitative improvements across standard pose, point cloud, and correspondence metrics. The paper explicitly notes trade-offs, showing that prioritizing multi-view geometry leads to lower performance on semantic recognition tasks.
primary.evaluation_assessment: The evaluation is extensive across diverse benchmarks and tasks, comparing frozen and finetuned backbones on feed-forward reconstruction (RE10K, ScanNet++, MegaDepth, ETH3D, DTU), zero-shot multi-view correspondence (ScanNet, NAVI), and SE(3) adapter probing. Meaningful ablations validate each component (image-level loss, teacher extra views, and removing local crops) against prior SSL baselines (MuM, Muskie, DINOv3).

evaluation_independence.corroboration_summary: Evaluation is conducted using ground-truth geometric annotations (camera poses, depths, and 3D point correspondences) on held-out benchmark datasets completely separate from the self-supervised pretraining objective.
evaluation_independence.final_evaluation_signal: External ground-truth 3D geometric metrics across established benchmarks: pose AUC on RE10K/ScanNet++/MegaDepth, point cloud error/normal consistency on ETH3D/DTU, and PCK correspondence matching on ScanNet and NAVI.
evaluation_independence.optimization_signal: Multi-view self-distillation loss comprising masked patch distillation, global CLS cross-entropy against an EMA teacher seeing additional views, and KoLeo regularization.

primary.limitations: The authors identify limitations transparently, including reduced semantic classification performance compared to DINOv3, hyperparameter sensitivity inherent to self-distillation frameworks, and heuristic/handcrafted frame selection from training videos.
primary.method_assessment: The methodology is described thoroughly with explicit objectives, architecture details, and pseudocode combining masked patch-level distillation, image-level global CLS distillation, and extra unmasked context views for the teacher network. Implementation details, training schedules, hyperparameters, and stability regularizations (Sinkhorn-Knopp, KoLeo) are adequately documented.
primary.quality_rationale: The manuscript presents a clear, well-motivated conceptual advance moving multi-view SSL away from appearance-entangling RGB pixel reconstruction to self-distillation. The system design is validated with thorough experiments, consistent baselines, clear ablation studies, and transparent reporting of limitations.
primary.scoped_contribution: The paper introduces Poincar3, a multi-view self-supervised representation learning method utilizing self-distillation rather than RGB reconstruction across views. It demonstrates emergent 3D geometric capabilities—such as zero-shot multi-view correspondence, SE(3) camera motion decodability, and strong feed-forward 3D reconstruction initialization—trained from scratch on unlabeled video and image collections.

scholarly_quality.rationale: The manuscript presents a clear, well-motivated conceptual advance moving multi-view SSL away from appearance-entangling RGB pixel reconstruction to self-distillation. The system design is validated with thorough experiments, consistent baselines, clear ablation studies, and transparent reporting of limitations.
scholarly_quality.uncertainty: The authors identify limitations transparently, including reduced semantic classification performance compared to DINOv3, hyperparameter sensitivity inherent to self-distillation frameworks, and heuristic/handcrafted frame selection from training videos.

limitations_or_uncertainty.value: Structured research-card claims use title, abstract/summary, metadata, screening rules, and curation. A separate scholarly-quality assessment used bounded full-text excerpts, but unsupported claim, method, or evidence fields remain unextracted.

relation_to_agentic_memory.value: Keypoint task that shares detection backbones and real-time constraints

research_relevance.value: Directly relevant to computer-vision research based on screening evidence.
